func TestBatch_Errors(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`CREATE TABLE `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s (id int primary key, val inet)`), table)))

	// Keep the invalid SELECT inside the native BATCH, so the server rejects
	// the batch itself rather than a preceding PREPARE operation.
	inet, err := ScalarType(TypeInet)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	bound, err := BindUnpreparedOwned(Statement[[]Value, Unit]{
		CQL:    fmt.Sprintf(("SELECT * FROM " + fixtureKeyspace("") + ".%s WHERE id=2 AND val=?"), table),
		Params: DynamicParams, Rows: NoRows,
	}, NewColumns(ColumnSpec{Name: "val", Type: inet}), []Value{NullValue(inet)})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer bound.Close()
	item, err := BatchEntry(bound)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{item}, Options{})
	require.Error(t, err, "expected to get error for invalid query in batch")
	var server RequestError
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &server)
}

func TestBatch_WithTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`CREATE TABLE `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s (id int primary key, val text)`), table)))
	micros := time.Now().UnixMicro() - 1000
	first := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf(("INSERT INTO "+fixtureKeyspace("")+".%s (id, val) VALUES (?, ?)"), table), IntValue(1), codecTestMust(TextValue("val")))
	defer first.Close()
	second := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf(("INSERT INTO "+fixtureKeyspace("")+".%s (id, val) VALUES (?, ?)"), table), IntValue(2), codecTestMust(TextValue("val")))
	defer second.Close()
	_, err := ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, first), sessionTestItem(t, second)}, Options{Timestamp: Option[int64]{Value: micros, Set: true}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, id := range []int32{1, 2} {
		row, err := v2ReadOne(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`SELECT writetime(val) AS written FROM `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s WHERE id = ?`), table), IntValue(id))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, micros, sessionTestInt(t, row, "written"))
	}
}

func TestBatch_WithNowInSeconds(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	if session.cfg.ProtoVersion < protoVersion5 {
		t.Skip("Batch now in seconds are only available on protocol >= 5")
	}
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE TABLE %s (id int primary key, val text)`, table)))
	bound := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id, val) VALUES (?, ?) USING TTL 20", table), IntValue(1), codecTestMust(TextValue("val")))
	defer bound.Close()
	_, err := ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, bound)}, Options{NowInSeconds: Option[int32]{Value: 0, Set: true}})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[int32, int32]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT TTL(val) FROM %s WHERE id = ?`, table), Params: OneParam(Int32), Rows: OneColumn(Int32)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	read, err := BindOwned(prepared, int32(1))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer read.Close()
	rows, err := Run(ctx, session, read, Options{NowInSeconds: Option[int32]{Value: 10, Set: true}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	require.True(t, rows.Next())
	require.Equal(t, int32(10), rows.Row())
	require.False(t, rows.Next())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
}

func TestBatch_SetKeyspace(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	if session.cfg.ProtoVersion < protoVersion5 {
		t.Skip("keyspace for BATCH message is not supported in protocol < 5")
	}
	const keyspace = "gocql_keyspace_override_test"
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, `CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS `+keyspace+` WITH replication = {'class': 'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor': '1'}`))
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "+keyspace+".batch_keyspace(id int, value text, PRIMARY KEY (id))"))
	// Explicit prepare keyspace and execution keyspace must agree. Unqualified
	// member CQL still exercises the v5 BATCH keyspace flag.
	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[[]Value, Unit]{CQL: "INSERT INTO batch_keyspace(id, value) VALUES (?, ?)", Params: DynamicParams, Rows: NoRows}, PrepareOptions{Keyspace: keyspace})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	first, err := BindOwned(prepared, []Value{IntValue(1), codecTestMust(TextValue("val1"))})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer first.Close()
	second, err := BindOwned(prepared, []Value{IntValue(2), codecTestMust(TextValue("val2"))})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer second.Close()
	_, err = ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, first), sessionTestItem(t, second)}, Options{Keyspace: keyspace})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	rows, err := v2Query(ctx, session, "SELECT id, value FROM "+keyspace+".batch_keyspace")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	got := map[int64]string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		row := rows.Row()
		value, err := row.Get("value")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		text, err := value.Text()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		got[sessionTestInt(t, row, "id")] = text.String()
	}
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
	require.Equal(t, map[int64]string{1: "val1", 2: "val2"}, got)
}

func TestTracing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	write := cassandraWriteBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id) VALUES (?)", table), []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	result, err := Exec(context.Background(), session, write, Options{Trace: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, result.TraceIDs)
	checkTrace := func(ids []UUID) {
		t.Helper()
		require.NotEmpty(t, ids)
		for _, id := range ids {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
			trace, err := session.Trace(ctx, id)
			cancel()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, id, trace.ID)
			require.NotEmpty(t, trace.Events)
		}
	}
	checkTrace(result.TraceIDs)
	read := cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id = ?", table), []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	// Options are explicit per execution; the same binding can be traced repeatedly.
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		rows, err := Run(context.Background(), session, read, Options{Trace: true})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer rows.Close()
		require.True(t, rows.Next())
		require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, rows.Row(), "id"))
		require.False(t, rows.Next())
		require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
		checkTrace(rows.Info().TraceIDs)
	}
}

func TestObserve(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	observer := &cassandraObserver{}
	check := func(stmt string, wantErr bool) {
		t.Helper()
		events, attempts := observer.snapshot()
		require.Len(t, events, 1)
		require.NotEmpty(t, attempts)
		require.Equal(t, stmt, events[0].Statement)
		require.Equal(t, fixtureKeyspace(""), events[0].Routing.Keyspace)
		require.Equal(t, wantErr, events[0].Err != nil)
	}
	selectCQL := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id = ?", table)
	read := cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(43)}, PrepareOptions{})
	rows, err := Run(context.Background(), session, read, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	require.False(t, rows.Next())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	insertCQL := fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id) VALUES (?)", table)
	write := cassandraWriteBound(t, session, insertCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	_, err = Exec(context.Background(), session, write, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	check(insertCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	read = cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, read, Options{Observer: observer}), "id"))
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	other := createV2Session(t, func(c *Config) { c.Observer = observer })
	defer other.Close()
	observer.reset()
	read = cassandraDynamicBound(t, other, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, cassandraReadBound(t, other, read, Options{}), "id"))
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	bad := cassandraUnprepared(t, "SELECT id FROM unknown_table WHERE id = 42", DynamicRows)
	_, err = Run(context.Background(), session, bad, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.Error(t, err)
	check("SELECT id FROM unknown_table WHERE id = 42", true)
}

func TestPagingWithBind(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int,val int,PRIMARY KEY(id,val))", table))
	for i := int32(0); i < 100; i++ {
		cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id,val) VALUES (?,?)", table), IntValue(1), IntValue(i))
	}
	prepared := cassandraPrepared(t, session, Statement[[]Value, DynamicRow]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT val FROM %s WHERE id=? AND val<?", table), Params: DynamicParams, Rows: DynamicRows}, PrepareOptions{})
	first := cassandraBound(t, prepared, []Value{IntValue(1), IntValue(50)})
	second := cassandraBound(t, prepared, []Value{IntValue(1), IntValue(20)})
	options := Options{PageSize: Option[int32]{Value: 10, Set: true}}
	require.Len(t, cassandraRows(t, session, first, options), 50)
	require.Len(t, cassandraRows(t, session, second, options), 20)
	require.Len(t, cassandraRows(t, session, first, options), 50, "new binding must not mutate old binding")
}

func TestMapScanCAS(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2SessionFromConfig(createV2Cluster(), t, true)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(title varchar,revid timeuuid,last_modified timestamp,deleted boolean,PRIMARY KEY(title,revid))", table))
	rev := NewTimeUUID()
	modified := Timestamp(time.Now().UnixMilli())
	bound := cassandraCASBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(title,revid,last_modified,deleted) VALUES(?,?,?,?) IF NOT EXISTS", table), []Value{codecTestMust(TextValue("baz")), cassandraValue(TimeUUIDValue(TimeUUID(rev))), TimestampValue(modified), BoolValue(false)}, DynamicRows)
	require.True(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{}).Applied)
	result := cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{})
	require.False(t, result.Applied)
	require.True(t, result.Previous.Set)
	row := result.Previous.Value
	require.Equal(t, "baz", cassandraText(t, row, "title"))
	got, e := cassandraField(t, row, "revid").UUID()
	require.NoError(t, e)
	require.Equal(t, rev, got)
	require.False(t, cassandraBool(t, row, "deleted"))
	require.Equal(t, int64(modified), cassandraInt(t, row, "last_modified"))
}

func TestReconnection(t *testing.T) {
	config := createV2Cluster(func(c *Config) { c.Reconnect = cassandraReconnect{} })
	session := createV2SessionFromConfig(config, t, false)
	defer session.Close()
	host := session.hostSource.getHostsList()[0]
	session.handleNodeDown(host.ConnectAddress(), host.Port())
	defer host.setState(NodeUp)
	require.Equal(t, NodeDown, host.State())
	require.True(t, pollUntil(31*time.Second, func() bool { return host.State() == NodeUp }), "host did not reconnect")
}

func TestMapScanWithRefMap(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(testtext text PRIMARY KEY,testfullname text,testint int)", table))
	type input struct {
		Text   string
		Name   FullName
		Number int32
	}
	params := Params(Param("testtext", StringEncoder, func(v input) string { return v.Text }), Param("testfullname", fullNameCodec{}, func(v input) FullName { return v.Name }), Param("testint", Int32, func(v input) int32 { return v.Number }))
	prepared := cassandraPrepared(t, session, Statement[input, Unit]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(testtext,testfullname,testint) VALUES(?,?,?)", table), Params: params, Rows: NoRows}, PrepareOptions{})
	_, err := Exec(context.Background(), session, cassandraBound(t, prepared, input{"testtext", FullName{"John", "Doe"}, 100}), Options{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	type output struct {
		Text   Text
		Name   FullName
		Number int32
	}
	decoder := Row(Column("testtext", TextCodec, func(v *output) *Text { return &v.Text }), Column("testfullname", fullNameCodec{}, func(v *output) *FullName { return &v.Name }), Column("testint", Int32, func(v *output) *int32 { return &v.Number }))
	got := cassandraReadBound(t, session, cassandraUnprepared(t, "SELECT * FROM "+table, decoder), Options{})
	require.Equal(t, "testtext", got.Text.String())
	require.Equal(t, FullName{"John", "Doe"}, got.Name)
	require.Equal(t, int32(100), got.Number)
	cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(testtext,testint) VALUES(?,?)", table), codecTestMust(TextValue("null-int")), NullValue(IntValue(0).Type()))
	nullable := cassandraPrepared(t, session, Statement[string, Nullable[int32]]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT testint FROM %s WHERE testtext=?", table), Params: OneParam(StringEncoder), Rows: OneColumn(NullableCodec(Int32))}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.False(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, cassandraBound(t, nullable, "null-int"), Options{}).Valid)
}

func TestSliceMap(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(testuuid timeuuid PRIMARY KEY,testtimestamp timestamp,testvarchar varchar,testbigint bigint,testblob blob,testbool boolean,testfloat float,testdouble double,testint int,testdecimal decimal,testlist list<text>,testset set<int>,testmap map<varchar,varchar>,testvarint varint,testinet inet)", table))
	textType, err := ScalarType(TypeVarchar)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	intType := IntValue(0).Type()
	listType, err := ListType(textType)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	setType, err := SetType(intType)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	varcharType, err := ScalarType(TypeVarchar)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	mapType, err := MapType(varcharType, varcharType)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	bigInt, ok := new(big.Int).SetString("830169365738487321165427203929228", 10)
	require.True(t, ok)
	expected := []ValueField{{"testuuid", cassandraValue(TimeUUIDValue(TimeUUID(NewTimeUUID())))}, {"testtimestamp", TimestampValue(Timestamp(time.Now().UnixMilli()))}, {"testvarchar", codecTestMust(TextValue("Test VarChar"))}, {"testbigint", BigIntValue(time.Now().Unix())}, {"testblob", BlobValue([]byte("test blob"))}, {"testbool", BoolValue(true)}, {"testfloat", FloatValue(4.564)}, {"testdouble", DoubleValue(4.815162342)}, {"testint", IntValue(2343)}, {"testdecimal", DecimalValue(Decimal{Unscaled: VarintFromBigInt(big.NewInt(100))})}, {"testlist", cassandraValue(ListValue(listType, []Value{codecTestMust(TextValue("quux")), codecTestMust(TextValue("foo")), codecTestMust(TextValue("bar")), codecTestMust(TextValue("baz")), codecTestMust(TextValue("quux"))}))}, {"testset", cassandraValue(SetValue(setType, []Value{IntValue(1), IntValue(2), IntValue(3), IntValue(4), IntValue(5), IntValue(6), IntValue(7), IntValue(8), IntValue(9)}))}, {"testmap", cassandraValue(MapValue(mapType, []ValueEntry{{codecTestMust(TextValue("field1")), codecTestMust(TextValue("val1"))}, {codecTestMust(TextValue("field2")), codecTestMust(TextValue("val2"))}, {codecTestMust(TextValue("field3")), codecTestMust(TextValue("val3"))}}))}, {"testvarint", VarintValue(VarintFromBigInt(bigInt))}, {"testinet", cassandraValue(InetValue(netip.MustParseAddr("213.212.2.19")))}}
	var values []Value
	for _, field := range expected {
		values = append(values, field.Value)
	}
	cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(testuuid,testtimestamp,testvarchar,testbigint,testblob,testbool,testfloat,testdouble,testint,testdecimal,testlist,testset,testmap,testvarint,testinet) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", table), values...)
	check := func(row DynamicRow) {
		t.Helper()
		require.Equal(t, len(expected), row.Columns().Len())
		for _, field := range expected {
			actual := cassandraField(t, row, field.Name)
			want, err := EncodeValueOwned(actual.Type(), DynamicCodec, field.Value)
			require.NoError(t, err, field.Name)
			got, err := EncodeValueOwned(actual.Type(), DynamicCodec, actual)
			require.NoError(t, err, field.Name)
			require.Equal(t, want.State(), got.State(), field.Name)
			require.Equal(t, want.Bytes().OwnedBytes(), got.Bytes().OwnedBytes(), field.Name)
		}
	}
	// Preserve the three result-consumption forms as cloned slices, a cursor,
	// and an exactly-one-row read, all with explicit dynamic values.
	bound := cassandraUnprepared(t, "SELECT * FROM "+table, DynamicRows)
	rows := cassandraRows(t, session, bound, Options{})
	require.Len(t, rows, 1)
	check(rows[0])
	cursor, err := Run(context.Background(), session, bound, Options{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer cursor.Close()
	require.True(t, cursor.Next())
	check(cursor.Row())
	require.NoError(t, cursor.Close())
	check(cassandraRead(t, session, "SELECT * FROM "+table))
}

func TestRoutingKey(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t, func(c *Config) { c.Metadata.SchemaEvents = false })
	defer session.Close()
	single, composite := testTableName(t, "single"), testTableName(t, "composite")
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(first_id int,second_id int,PRIMARY KEY(first_id,second_id))", single))
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(first_id int,second_id int,PRIMARY KEY((first_id,second_id)))", composite))
	runtime := session.typedRuntime()
	runtime.mu.Lock()
	initial := len(runtime.prepared)
	runtime.mu.Unlock()
	for i, tc := range []struct {
		table   string
		indexes []int
		key     []byte
	}{{single, []int{1}, []byte{0, 0, 0, 2}}, {composite, []int{1, 0}, []byte{0, 4, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 4, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0}}} {
		statement := Statement[[]Value, DynamicRow]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE second_id=? AND first_id=?", tc.table), Params: DynamicParams, Rows: DynamicRows}
		prepared := cassandraPrepared(t, session, statement, PrepareOptions{})
		require.Equal(t, tc.indexes, prepared.Info().PartitionKeyIndexes)
		for _, index := range tc.indexes {
			column, ok := prepared.Parameters().At(index)
			require.True(t, ok)
			require.Equal(t, TypeInt, column.Type.Kind())
		}
		again := cassandraPrepared(t, session, statement, PrepareOptions{})
		require.Same(t, prepared.state, again.state, "preparing again must hit typed cache")
		bound := cassandraBound(t, prepared, []Value{IntValue(1), IntValue(2)})
		key, present, err := newPartitionKey(bound.request.values.cells, prepared.Info().PartitionKeyIndexes)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.True(t, present)
		var keyBytes []byte
		require.NoError(t, key.ForEach(func(span Bytes) error { keyBytes = append(keyBytes, span.OwnedBytes()...); return nil }))
		require.Equal(t, tc.key, keyBytes, "canonical single/composite partition-key bytes")
		require.True(t, bound.Routing().Token.Set)
		require.Equal(t, murmur.Murmur3H1(tc.key), bound.Routing().Token.Value)
		runtime.mu.Lock()
		size := len(runtime.prepared)
		runtime.mu.Unlock()
		require.Equal(t, initial+i+1, size)
	}
}

func TestPrepareExecuteScyllaEmptyMetadataID(t *testing.T) {
	session := createV2Session(t, func(c *Config) {
		c.Metadata.SchemaEvents = false
		c.Metadata.AutomaticAgreement = false
		c.Metadata.RefreshAfterAgreement = false
	})
	defer session.Close()
	conn := getRandomConn(t, session)
	if conn.version&protoVersionMask != protoVersion4 {
		t.Skip("SCYLLA_USE_METADATA_ID is negotiated on protocol v4 only")
	}
	if !conn.scyllaSupported.IsMetadataIDSupported() {
		t.Skip("server does not advertise SCYLLA_USE_METADATA_ID")
	}
	require.True(t, conn.usesMetadataID(), "server advertises metadata IDs but driver did not negotiate them")
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(id int PRIMARY KEY,val int)", table))
	cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id,val) VALUES(?,?)", table), IntValue(1), IntValue(7))
	host := Option[UUID]{Value: conn.host.hostUUID(), Set: true}
	prepared := cassandraPrepared(t, session, Statement[int32, DynamicRow]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id,val FROM %s WHERE id=?", table), Params: OneParam(Int32), Rows: DynamicRows}, PrepareOptions{HostID: host, connection: conn})
	bound := cassandraBound(t, prepared, int32(1))
	cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{HostID: host, connection: conn})
	prepared.state.mu.Lock()
	entry, ok := prepared.state.hosts[host.Value]
	require.True(t, ok)
	cached := *entry
	require.NotEmpty(t, cached.metadataID)
	cached.metadataID = nil
	cached.revision++
	prepared.state.hosts[host.Value] = &cached
	prepared.state.mu.Unlock()
	row := cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{HostID: host, connection: conn})
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), cassandraInt(t, row, "id"))
	require.Equal(t, int64(7), cassandraInt(t, row, "val"))
	prepared.state.mu.RLock()
	healed := prepared.state.hosts[host.Value]
	prepared.state.mu.RUnlock()
	require.NotEmpty(t, healed.metadataID, "empty metadata ID must be repaired from response")
	require.True(t, healed.metadataChanged)
	require.Greater(t, healed.revision, cached.revision)
}

	_, err = Exec(ctx, session, bound, Options{})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrClosed)

func TestQueryBasicAPI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table)))
	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[int32, Unit]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id) VALUES (?)", table), Params: OneParam(Int32), Rows: NoRows}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, prepared.Parameters().Len())
	require.Equal(t, table, prepared.Info().Table)
	original, err := BindOwned(prepared, int32(1))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer original.Close()
	rebound, err := BindOwned(prepared, int32(2))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rebound.Close()

	// Query setters become per-admission Options. Trace IDs and timing belong
	// to each execution result; a Bound never accumulates mutable metrics.
	zero := Result{}
	require.Zero(t, zero.Attempts)
	require.Zero(t, zero.Latency)
	retry := sessionTestRetry{action: RetryNext, maxAttempts: 3}
	observer := new(sessionTestObserver)
	options := Options{Consistency: Option[Consistency]{Value: All, Set: true}, SerialConsistency: Option[Option[Consistency]]{Value: Option[Consistency]{Value: LocalSerial, Set: true}, Set: true}, PageSize: Option[int32]{Value: 10, Set: true}, Prefetch: Option[int]{Value: 1, Set: true}, Retry: retry, Trace: true, Observer: observer}
	resolved, err := resolveOptions(session, options)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, All, resolved.profile.Consistency)
	require.Equal(t, LocalSerial, resolved.profile.SerialConsistency.Value)
	require.Equal(t, int32(10), resolved.profile.PageSize)
	require.Equal(t, 1, resolved.profile.Prefetch)
	require.Equal(t, retry, resolved.profile.Retry)
	serialRead := options
	serialRead.Consistency.Value = LocalSerial
	resolvedSerial, err := resolveOptions(session, serialRead)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, LocalSerial, resolvedSerial.profile.Consistency)

	for _, bound := range []*Bound[Unit]{original, rebound, original} {
		result, err := Exec(ctx, session, bound, options)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, 1, result.Attempts)
		require.Greater(t, result.Latency, time.Duration(0))
		require.Equal(t, All, result.AchievedConsistency)
		require.NotEmpty(t, result.TraceIDs)
	}
	requests, attempts := observer.snapshot()
	require.Len(t, requests, 3)
	require.Len(t, attempts, 3)
	for i := range attempts {
		require.Equal(t, 1, attempts[i].Attempt)
		require.NoError(t, attempts[i].Err)
	}
	for _, id := range []int32{1, 2} {
		row, err := v2ReadOne(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id=?", table), IntValue(id))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, int64(id), sessionTestInt(t, row, "id"))
	}
	// Freeze a profile at admission, then replace it while the request remains
	// admitted. This directly covers the setter-to-snapshot migration boundary.
	profile := session.typedRuntime().profile.Snapshot()
	profile.PageSize = 10
	handle, err := NewProfile(profile)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, cancel, admitted, err := admitExecution(ctx, session, original, Options{Profile: handle})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	profile.PageSize = 100
	require.NoError(t, handle.Replace(profile))
	require.Equal(t, int32(10), admitted.options.profile.PageSize)
	require.Equal(t, int32(100), handle.Snapshot().PageSize)
	admitted.logical.finish(Result{}, nil)
	admitted.owner.release()
	cancel()
	original.Close()
	require.NoError(t, original.Wait(ctx))
	_, err = Exec(ctx, session, original, Options{})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrClosed)
}

func TestBatchBasicAPI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	retry := sessionTestRetry{action: RetryNext, maxAttempts: 2}
	session := createV2Session(t, func(config *Config) {
		profile := config.DefaultProfile.Snapshot()
		profile.Retry = retry
		require.NoError(t, config.DefaultProfile.Replace(profile))
	})
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table)))
	first := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id) VALUES (?)", table), IntValue(1))
	defer first.Close()
	second := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id) VALUES (?)", table), IntValue(2))
	defer second.Close()
	items := []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, first), sessionTestItem(t, second)}
	require.Len(t, items, 2)
	inherited, err := resolveOptions(session, Options{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, retry, inherited.profile.Retry)
	override := sessionTestRetry{action: RetryNext, maxAttempts: 4}
	observer := new(sessionTestObserver)
	options := Options{Consistency: Option[Consistency]{Value: One, Set: true}, Retry: override, Trace: true, Observer: observer}
	resolved, err := resolveOptions(session, options)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, override, resolved.profile.Retry)
	require.Equal(t, One, resolved.profile.Consistency)
	require.True(t, resolved.options.Trace)
	// Native batch kind remains explicit; entries are immutable bound plans.
	// Per-request Result/Observer replace attempts/latency on a mutable batch.
	require.Zero(t, (Result{}).Attempts)
	require.Zero(t, (Result{}).Latency)
	for _, kind := range []BatchKind{UnloggedBatch, LoggedBatch} {
		result, err := ExecBatch(ctx, session, kind, items, options)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, 1, result.Attempts)
		require.Greater(t, result.Latency, time.Duration(0))
		require.Equal(t, One, result.AchievedConsistency)
		require.NotEmpty(t, result.TraceIDs)
	}
	requests, attempts := observer.snapshot()
	require.Len(t, requests, 2)
	require.Len(t, attempts, 2)
	for _, request := range requests {
		require.Len(t, request.BatchStatements, 2)
	}
	for _, id := range []int32{1, 2} {
		row, err := v2ReadOne(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id=?", table), IntValue(id))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, int64(id), sessionTestInt(t, row, "id"))
	}
	// BatchEntry is only a descriptor. Closing any member prevents the entire
	// batch admission, and other members remain available for separate work.
	first.Close()
	_, err = ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, items, options)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrClosed)
	require.NoError(t, first.Wait(ctx))
	_, err = Exec(ctx, session, second, Options{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
}
